title: CareerBliss Reviews Scraper
description: Collect employee reviews from CareerBliss company pages.

urls.title: CareerBliss URLs
urls.description: CareerBliss company or review page URLs, for example https://www.careerbliss.com/cisco-systems/reviews/. Each URL accepts an optional location or job-title filter.

results_wanted.title: Results wanted
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of reviews to save across the whole run.

max_pages.title: Maximum pages per URL
max_pages.description: Maximum number of review pages to scan for each URL.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: CareerBliss blocks direct requests from cloud data centers, so Apify Proxy is enabled by default. Turn it off only for a local run from a residential connection.
